title: Idea Research: Mythtide Feedback
author: Secret_Mastodon5597
selftext:
I built something this year I wanted to play that is inspired by a love of Text adventures and classic MUDs but with more pictures and accessible from a phone. 

It works and has been fun for me and the kids to play but want to tweak this to figure out it's niche and target user. I've not released it on a store or publicly, looking for some feedback before opening it up on a beta or limited trial.

It's an all Java backend with a real-time Diku-style combat engine: rooms, mobs, combat rounds, spells and skills. Front-end is a Flutter app for web, iOS and Android. Much of the play parts I put together a terminal/ASCII colored UI and a bookish style for the story creation. 

You can play a few standard Diku zones, or play a few I've made but it has a real good area editor to make and draft your own zones, rooms, mobs and items and play thru. Rather than spend 100+ hours making a zone, AI assistance can really cut down the time in making a cool zone with pictures, creatures and items to explore on your own or with friends.

What I'd love to know: after 10 seconds on \[[mythtide.com](https://mythtide.com/)\] and \[[knowledgebase](https://help.test.mythtide.com/)\], what do you think it is? And would you, as a text player or developer, want any of this?

If you have 20 minutes, there's a short questionnaire: \[[Anonymous Google Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSclls8wQN6kWtIsUizk2WZpyn4TbN_VltjgXMNnRab1MTU9ZQ/viewform?usp=header)\]. Blunt answers are the most useful. Happy to talk game design too.
